patch.comment: Auto-play tests poll for the advanced slide instead of sleeping a fixed 80 ms (flaked on loaded CI runners); no runtime change

Fix an issue where `provision` did not follow slides added or removed, and `last-move` and `content-carousel-slide-changed` did not follow `is-active` moving from one slide to another (a swipe): each change sets one provision, and a carousel moved in the DOM no longer sets it again
Update the internal `autoPlayIntervalId` property to `_autoPlayIntervalId`, as its other private properties are named; it was never an attribute, so markup is unaffected
Ship only dist (and declared extras) in the npm tarball; drop build logs, tests and sources
